title: PDS MPP: Project Plan Editor
shortDescription: Stage requested plan edits informed by authorized M365 context.
longDescription:
PDS MPP Plan Editor helps project managers, planners, and PMO analysts apply specific changes to Microsoft Project (.mpp) plans in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams. Select a plan you can access and describe the requested change. The agent can use accessible OneDrive or SharePoint files, email, and Teams messages as planning context, then stage and validate supported edits to tasks, progress, dependencies, resources, and assignments. A clear, explicit edit request may authorize the agent to commit that change. Analysis or a draft-only request does not authorize a save. Not every Microsoft Project field or operation is supported.

For session-only output, the host's download app delivers the resulting MPP; this is not a cloud write-back. To save to OneDrive or SharePoint, you must explicitly request write-back, the destination and file must be resolved, you must have write permission, and the Teams host confirmation must be completed. A preview or successful validation alone does not prove that a file was saved; open the result to verify it.

You need Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams, a PDS connection, and permission to access the selected plan and any OneDrive or SharePoint files, email, or Teams messages used as context. On first sign-in to PDS, an account is created automatically and you may be asked to consent. Teams sign-in alone does not sign you in to PDS. Search is limited to content your account can access. Usage is subject to account limits. Supported language: English. For help, visit https://projectdata.io/contact-us or email support@projectdata.io.
